prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animated water texture atlas for a cohesive HD2D overhead RPG, Stardew Valley / FireRed inspired. EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows equal square tiles, no separators or borders. Eight consecutive animation frames of SAME shallow teal-blue water surface, looping smoothly: small soft ripples drift diagonally and reflected sunlight moves gradually. Each cell water only edge to edge, seamless repeat in X and Y, no shoreline, land, plants, rocks or lily pads. Restrained soft painted pixel-inspired texture with broad quiet areas and sparse gentle curved highlights, no dense high contrast diamond checker pattern. Overhead orthographic view, consistent moderate lighting, subtle natural watercolor materials, soft cyan highlights, no white foam grids. Each frame visibly different but coherent wave displacement, no abrupt palette changes. No text, labels or UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. One seamless repeating grass ground texture for cohesive HD2D overhead RPG inspired by Stardew Valley and Pokemon FireRed. Quiet softly painted mossy meadow greens, moderate saturation, broad gentle natural color variations and a FEW small clumps of readable grass blades. Low contrast so characters and collectible items remain focal points. Direct overhead orthographic ground plane, even soft warm daylight, painted pixel-inspired detailed material but NO photographic noise or busy tiny checker texture. All four edges seamless, no vignette or dark tile edges. No flowers, trees, bushes, path, stones, objects or text. Uniform ground fills entire square. Natural sage and meadow-green palette, avoid electric neon green and avoid dense sharp blade stippling.
